issue.title: Make failed agent sessions and clans unmistakable
issue.description: When an agent session or clan stops on a failure, every Agents-tab surface says so: the row, the BY_STATUS section, the count chips, the waves and jump strips, and the detail panels all read FAILED and agree with each other. The cause and the next step are one glance away. A staged handoff the host refused to adopt shows as NOT ADOPTED, never as a phantom RUNNING with a ticking clock.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202611/failed_clan_visibility.md requests this work

issue.title: Project held staged monitors as a first-class state in sase-core
issue.description: core-held: in sase-core, project a staged monitor member whose `monitor_stage_held` flag is set as monitor turn state `held`. Add `NOT ADOPTED` to the status-bucket table as Failed, teach the staged-membership facts about `held`, expose a binding for Python fallback loaders, and make previously indexed held members re-project.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/failed_clan_visibility.md defines phase core-held as one work unit

issue.title: Consume the held state in sase and keep the held flag truthful
issue.description: held-state: bucket `held` as Failed but nonterminal and never in flight. Show the member as `NOT ADOPTED ‖` with no ticking clock, move it to the settled monitor lane, and route the filesystem fallback loaders through the binding. Make every not-adopted path set the durable held flag and every successful readopt clear it.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/failed_clan_visibility.md defines phase held-state as one work unit

issue.title: One failure-aware session rollup that every surface consumes
issue.description: session-rollup: not-adopted members never count as started work. A failed turn stays the session's state until a real later turn supersedes it, for both plan and plain roots. Clan roster, waves, tribe summary, BY_STATUS, and count chips all read the one session rollup. A `FailureFocus` record carries the cause to presentation, and a cross-surface consistency test pins it all.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/failed_clan_visibility.md defines phase session-rollup as one work unit

issue.title: Failure signals on Agents-tab rows, waves, and jump strips
issue.description: row-signals: render the failure clearly in the list. Add a clan-row cause chip naming the failed member and its cause, show the failure time instead of a running hourglass on Failed rollups, and draw a red ✗ wave pip and ▶→✗ in WAVES. Put the ‖ glyph in SESSION TURNS and add a visual golden for the incident shape.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/failed_clan_visibility.md defines phase row-signals as one work unit

issue.title: NEEDS ATTENTION callout in session and clan detail panels, plus docs
issue.description: attention-callout: a left-barred NEEDS ATTENTION callout at the top of the session and clan detail panels. It says which turn failed, the cause, any not-adopted handoff, the downstream members it blocks, and the exact next step. The tribe NEEDS ATTENTION entry reuses it. Update the status, glyph, and monitor docs, and add panel goldens.
